about: Collector-only gazetteer top-up (Batch 3, 23 Oct 2026): sections, villages and police areas the four town sweeps named that GeoNames and za_places_topup.json lack. Read only by forage/collectors/infra_signals.locate(); tools/publish.py does not read this file, so the map's place list is unchanged. Points marked estimated: true are not the place itself but the nearest sourced point, with the reason in 'point_basis'. 'context': words (folded, lower case) that make the entry count as in-province and as more specific than its parent town when the text names them. 'context_required': true means the entry only matches when one of those words is in the text (names that also exist elsewhere). 'precinct' (optional): the station the source names, used instead of the outline holding an estimated point.

places.name: Matswale
places.point_basis: Matswale is on no map we hold; GeoNames 'Musina-Nancefield' (PPLX) township point, the same point the published Matswale Phase 12 pin uses. Not confirmed that Matswale is in Nancefield.
places.source: collector top-up: GeoNames Musina-Nancefield; Musina sweep 23 Oct (Limpopo Mirror, 16 Oct)
